summary.text: Naquetta Ricks is a Democrat who represents District 40 (Arapahoe County) in the Colorado House of Representatives, where she took office on January 13, 2021; Ballotpedia lists her as on the November 2026 general election ballot for re-election.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia says Ricks was born in Liberia, graduated from Aurora Central High School, earned a bachelor's and a master's degree in business administration, and has operated a mortgage brokerage business.
